description: This file defines a class 'LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler' that implements logic to determine whether a leave period is defined for a user, used to direct users to define leave period if not already set.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler
classes.description: A class that checks if the leave period is defined and helps control the homepage behavior related to leave period setup.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if the leave period is not defined, guiding the user to the leave period setup page if necessary.
